title: Wreck Riot Alpha V1.7 — Armor & Destruction Update!
author: Candid-Cauliflower-4
selftext: major update on my end, still working on it still in alpha stage. hopefully you guys like it

comments.author: WWEtrump
comments.body: armor plus destruction in one update sounds like a fun combo to build. are your broken pieces pre-cut chunks or does it fracture at runtime? i went pre-cut and it's been a long road

replies.author: Candid-Cauliflower-4
replies.body:
Thanks! I went with pre-cut chunks rather than true runtime fracturing. Buildings use predefined destructible sections, while vehicles have modular armor panels that break off as they take damage.

I also prebuild and cache some of the damage geometry to avoid performance spikes. Since Wreck Riot runs in browsers and on mobile, keeping destruction lightweight has been a big priority.

It's definitely been a challenge getting everything to look dynamic without hurting performance 

What's been the hardest part of the pre-cut approach for you?

replies.author: WWEtrump
replies.body: pre-cut chunks with cached damage geometry is a smart way to dodge the perf spikes. mine also break into set brick pieces, so i feel that. do your buildings ever rise up piece by piece when they get built, or are they just there?

replies.author: Candid-Cauliflower-4
replies.body:
Right now the buildings are already standing when the match starts. Wreck Riot is more focused on vehicular combat and destruction, so I've been concentrating on making buildings break apart when cars crash into them or weapons hit them.

Some buildings have destructible sections, while larger structures only take localized damage to keep performance manageable.

Having buildings assemble piece by piece would actually be pretty cool, though! 😂

Does your game have a construction system where the bricks get placed individually?
